fix.summary: Sustain the Spec finding as a current type-boundary defect at HEAD `1a45c4e`; no Plan or owner choice remains. Runtime validation enforces evidence on success, but the exported receipt, runner-result, and ledger-result types still admit successful outcomes without it. Dismiss the Standards finding: the `--no-session` manifests are immutable historical receipts, with the newest located invocation committed before `2858a824` introduced the native-session rule; current Review-038 itself records Recorder-owned `--session-dir` and `--session-id`. Rewriting those manifests would launder invocation truth, not repair current construction.

classes.name: Discriminated successful materialization outcomes
classes.owner: `src/package-contracts/reviewer-output.ts` owns the public V2 outcome contract; `src/reviewer-agent.ts` owns runner outcomes; `src/reviewer-execution-ledger.ts` owns settled-result evidence; `src/reviewer-settlement.ts` assembles those typed branches.
classes.boundary: Replace each shared optional-field outcome shape with a `status`-discriminated union. The successful branch must require `runtimeConstructionEvidence: MaterializedBundleEvidenceV1` and exclude failure; the failed branch must require its failure classification and may omit evidence only when materialization did not complete. Carry that distinction through `ReviewerSuccessfulLegRunResult`, `ReviewerLegResultEvidence`, and `RuntimeReviewerOutcome`, so settlement projects required success evidence directly rather than conditionally. Preserve failed evidence whenever already materialized, and preserve all existing leg, manifest, entry, prompt, report, and workspace validation laws.
classes.disposition: Direct Fixer Apply. Add compile-time contract assertions that a successful runner/ledger/receipt outcome without evidence is rejected while a pre-materialization failure may omit it and a post-materialization failure may carry it. Add or sharpen validator/assembly regressions proving missing successful evidence is rejected, assembled successful evidence is retained exactly, and failed evidence remains optional/preserved according to lifecycle. Update production-lifecycle assertions to access successful evidence as required rather than through optional chaining; do not alter historical dockets or add a parallel validator.

Review-038’s manifest records `.ak/work/issues/17/runs/review-038-final/session` and a session ID.
